description_en: Queries the request traffic and response traffic of a dedicated instance within a period of time
description_zh: 查看专享实例一定时间内请求和应答流量
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi describe-instance-traffic --start-time 2022-03-31T03:42:00Z --end-time 2022-04-01T06:34:03Z --stage-name RELEASE --instance-id apigateway-cn-2r426lavr001 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceTraffic

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The environment in which the API runs. Valid values:

RELEASE: the production environment

PRE: the pre-release environment

TEST: the test environment
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的环境。

RELEASE：线上
PRE：预发
TEST：测试
parameters.name: stage_name

MonitorItem.description_en: The traffic consumed by the requests and responses in the instance
MonitorItem.description_zh: 实例的请求流量和应答流量

Item.description_en:
The metric. Valid values:

inbound: traffic consumed by requests

outbound: traffic consumed by responses
Item.description_zh:
指标
inbound 请求流量
outbound 应答流量

ItemTime.description_en: The monitoring time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
ItemTime.description_zh: 对应时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

ItemValue.description_en: The amount of traffic consumed by the requests and responses in the instance
